At PwC India and EY India, improved client security posture by up to 40% and reduced compliance gaps by 30% through control testing, risk reporting, and remediation planning.

work.name: Ernst & Young (EY) India
highlights: Performed technology-risk and internal-control assessments aligned with NIST CSF, IEC 62443, and ISO/IEC 27001:2022 to strengthen control effectiveness and compliance readiness.
Supported SOX 404 and internal audit activities by evaluating IT/OT controls, documenting test evidence, and recommending remediation for control gaps.
Assessed OT network switches, firewalls, and architecture, then redesigned Purdue-model network diagrams to improve segmentation and defense-in-depth.
Collaborated with IT, cybersecurity, network, and infrastructure teams and provided periodic status updates to ensure timely closure of risk and audit deliverables.

work.name: PwC India (PricewaterhouseCoopers)
highlights: Conducted IT and OT cybersecurity audits, including IT General Controls (ITGC) testing, against ISO 27001:2022 and NIST CSF 2.0, delivering maturity assessments and risk reports that improved client security posture by up to 40%.
Developed policies, procedures, and As-Is/To-Be network diagrams aligned with regulatory standards, reducing compliance gaps by 30%.
Used Claroty, Nozomi Networks, Wireshark, and Tenable to identify vulnerabilities, assess risk, and support remediation in industrial OT environments, cutting critical vulnerabilities by 25%.
Created Power BI dashboards for vulnerabilities and control gaps and prepared management reports that improved stakeholder decision-making.
Executed on-site ISO 27001:2022 IT/OT assessments for a steel manufacturer, producing gap reports and risk registers that enabled successful certification and reduced OT-environment risks by 35%.

projects.description: Conducted on-site ISO 27001:2022 IT/OT assessments; delivered gap reports, risk registers, and dashboards that enabled successful certification and reduced OT-environment risks by 35%.

projects.description: Conducted NIST (SP 800-30/SP 800-53) and IEC 62443 based IT/OT audits; delivered risk and gap registers, dashboards, and To-Be network architecture recommendations that reduced identified risks by 30%.
